messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square that maximizes the minimum triangle area places 4 points at the corners of the square and 9 points along the boundary, specifically at the midpoints of 9 equal segments dividing each side. This achieves a minimum triangle area of 1/18, as the smallest triangles are formed by two adjacent boundary points on one side and a single point on the opposite side. This configuration is optimal because it maximizes the spreading of points on the boundary, minimizing the smallest possible triangle area, and any interior point would create a smaller triangle with two adjacent boundary points."}
